display.label: Storage Account
display.description: Azure Storage Account providing scalable cloud storage for blobs, files, queues, and tables

resource.key_description: The globally unique name of the Azure Storage Account. Must be between 3 and 24 lowercase alphanumeric characters. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core storage account settings, location, tier, and replication.

fields.label: Storage Account Name
fields.description: The name of the Azure Storage Account. Must be globally unique across Azure, between 3 and 24 characters, and contain only lowercase letters and numbers.

validation.pattern_error: Storage Account name must be between 3 and 24 characters and contain only lowercase letters and numbers.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Storage Account.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Storage Account should be created.

fields.label: Account Tier
fields.description: Defines the performance tier to use for this storage account: Standard or Premium.

fields.label: Replication Type
fields.description: Defines the redundancy/replication strategy for the storage account.

fields.label: Account Kind
fields.description: Defines the type of storage account. StorageV2 is recommended for modern workloads.

fields.label: Access Tier
fields.description: Defines the default access tier for BlobStorage and StorageV2 accounts.

sections.label: Security & Network Access
sections.description: Public network access, encryption, TLS, and network rules.

fields.label: Enable Public Network Access
fields.description: Specifies whether public network access is allowed for the storage account.

fields.label: Minimum TLS Version
fields.description: The minimum supported TLS version for incoming requests. TLS 1.2 is required by Azure.

fields.label: Enforce HTTPS Traffic Only
fields.description: Forces all requests to the storage account to be transmitted over HTTPS.

fields.label: Allow Public Blob Access
fields.description: Permit or deny public read access to containers and blobs within this account.

fields.label: Enable Shared Key Access
fields.description: Indicates whether requests can be authorized using the account access keys via Shared Key.

fields.label: Default to OAuth Authentication
fields.description: Default to Azure Active Directory authorization when accessing the Storage Account in the Azure portal.

fields.label: Enable Infrastructure Encryption
fields.description: Enables double encryption of data at rest (at both service and infrastructure levels).

fields.label: Network Rules
fields.description: Network access control rules restricting traffic by IP or Subnet.

fields.label: Default Action
fields.description: Default action when no rule matches: Allow or Deny.

fields.label: Traffic Bypass
fields.description: List of services that can bypass network rules (e.g., AzureServices, Logging, Metrics).

fields.label: Allowed IP Rules
fields.description: List of public IP addresses or CIDR blocks allowed access.

fields.label: Allowed Subnet IDs
fields.description: List of virtual network subnet resource IDs allowed access.

sections.label: Features & Capabilities
sections.description: Data lake hierarchical namespace, NFSv3, large file shares, and SFTP.

fields.label: Enable Hierarchical Namespace (ADLS Gen2)
fields.description: Enables Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 hierarchical directory structure.

fields.label: Enable NFSv3 Protocol
fields.description: Enables Network File System v3 protocol support (requires is_hns_enabled).

fields.label: Enable Large File Shares
fields.description: Enables Azure Files shares up to 100 TiB.

fields.label: Enable Cross-Tenant Replication
fields.description: Allow object replication across different Azure Active Directory tenants.

fields.label: Enable SFTP Support
fields.description: Enables SSH File Transfer Protocol for blob storage (requires is_hns_enabled).

fields.label: Edge Zone
fields.description: Specifies the Edge Zone within the Azure Region where this Storage Account should exist.

fields.label: Blob Service Properties
fields.description: Configure blob service settings like versioning, change feed, and soft delete retention.

fields.label: Enable Blob Versioning
fields.description: Is blob versioning enabled for point-in-time recovery of blobs.

fields.label: Enable Change Feed
fields.description: Is blob change feed event logging enabled.

fields.label: Blob Soft Delete Retention (Days)
fields.description: Number of days that deleted blobs should be retained (between 1 and 365). Leave empty/null to disable.

fields.label: Container Soft Delete Retention (Days)
fields.description: Number of days that deleted containers should be retained (between 1 and 365). Leave empty/null to disable.

fields.label: Managed Identity
fields.description: Managed Service Identity configuration for the storage account.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.description: Type of Managed Service Identity: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, or SystemAssigned, UserAssigned.

fields.label: User Assigned Identity IDs
fields.description: A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for categorization, governance, and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to tag the storage account for organization and billing.
